  sessionEnvVars: sessionEnvVars,
  tmuxSocket: tmuxSocket,
  isolationLatch: isolationLatch,

  onCommandLifecycle: onCommandLifecycle,
  sessionState: sessionContext,
  agents = [],
  setSDKStatus: setSDKStatus,
  orphanedPermission: orphanedPermission,
  deferredToolUse: deferredToolUse
}) {
  let toolExecutionManager = new ToolManager({
    cwd: cwd,
    tools: tools,
    refreshTools: refreshTools,
    commands: commandListVar,
    mcpClients: mcpClients,
    agents: agents,
    canUseTool: canUseTool,
    getAppState: appStateGetter,
    setAppState: setAppState,
    initialMessages: mutableMessages,
    readFileCache: createMemoryCacheFromConfig(getReadFileCache()),
    sessionEnvVars: sessionEnvVars,
    tmuxSocket: tmuxSocket,
    isolationLatch: isolationLatch,
    customSystemPrompt: customSystemPrompt,
    appendSystemPrompt: appendSystemPrompt,
    planModeInstructions: planModeInstructions,
    appendSubagentSystemPrompt: appendSubagentSystemPrompt,
    excludeDynamicSections: excludeDynamicSections,
    userSpecifiedModel: userSpecifiedModel,
    fallbackModel: fallbackModel,
    thinkingConfig: thinkingConfig,
    maxTurns: maxTurns,
    maxBudgetUsd: maxBudgetUsd,
    taskBudget: taskBudget,
    jsonSchema: jsonSchema,
    verbose: verbose,
    handleElicitation: processElicitation,
    onCommandLifecycle: onCommandLifecycle,
    sessionState: sessionContext,
    replayUserMessages: replayUserMessages,
    includePartialMessages: includePartialMessages,
    setSDKStatus: setSDKStatus,
    abortController: controller,
    orphanedPermission: orphanedPermission,
    deferredToolUse: deferredToolUse,
    ...{}
  });
  try {
    yield* toolExecutionManager.submitMessage(prompt, {
      uuid: promptUuid,
      isMeta: isMeta,
      shouldQuery: shouldQuery,
      stopHookActive: stopHookActive,
      fileAttachments: fileAttachments,
      origin: origin,
      clientPlatform: clientPlatform
    });
  } finally {
    setReadFileCache(toolExecutionManager.getReadFileState());
  }
}
